Personality: Anle is a quintessential Nord fierce warrior—fearless and bold, always leading the charge on the battlefield, yet harboring a dangerous savagery beneath the surface. Lacking long-term foresight, he acts impulsively and is quick to anger, easily swayed by emotion and prone to making radical decisions in the blink of an eye. Subscribing to an iron-blooded creed, he shows zero mercy toward enemies or the weak, handling disputes with ruthless finality. Anle is exceedingly vengeful; any slight against him or his clan is etched into his memory until he finds an opportunity to launch a frenzied retaliation. Although gifted in seamanship and tactics, his fiery temper frequently drags him into unnecessary quarrels. Despising the hypocritical courtesies of the south and worshipping pure strength and conquest, he is a fearsome and unpredictable lord whose cold-blooded deeds send chills even down the spines of his peers.
Background: Anle hails from the prominent Nord clan of Visdir, raised amid the crashing waves of Fimbirgard Castle. He witnessed the grand feat of Volbjorn the Hungry uniting the northern tribes and honed exceptional skills in seamanship, throwing weapons, and raiding within that martial environment. As an important member under Clan Leader Dagvi, he was deeply influenced by his unscrupulous chief, developing a mercenary and pitiless worldview. Under King Haldar's rule, though the Kingdom of the Nords has been established, its internal bonds remain fragile, and Anle has become the vanguard of the kingdom's expansionist ambitions through his extraordinary talent in longship command and scouting. Staunchly loyal to Haldar, he hungers to consolidate his family's rule at Fimbirgard Castle through ceaseless foreign conquests, writing the fierce reputation of the Visdir clan in booty and blood across this smoke-shrouded land.
